newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SOCIALISTS HOLD SLIGHT LEAD OVER CONSERVATIVES - PRC POLL.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SOCIALISTS HOLD SLIGHT LEAD OVER CONSERVATIVES - PRC POLL.

text.p: The Greek socialists hold a narrow lead over the conservatives according to a nationwide poll conducted by private PRC polling company and published in daily Nea today.
The results of the poll which covered all Greece except for the Aegean and the Ionian islands follow:
The poll was taken between August 31 and September 6. The sample included 1,624 persons.
Another poll conducted by private MRB put the conservatives ahead by a marginal 0.4 percent, 31 percent to socialists' 30.6 percent.
